title: ZX Bank – Branch Network in Bhutan

nodes.title: Thimphu Region
nodes.summary: Thimphu region has two branches — one near the Clock Tower, Norzin Lam, Thimphu, and one on the 1st floor of City Mall, Changlam, Thimphu — with IFSC codes ZXIN000BT01 and ZXIN000BT02.

nodes.title: Paro Region
nodes.summary: Paro region has two branches — Main Street, Paro Town (ZXIN000BP01) and Opposite Paro Airport Entrance, Shaba (ZXIN000BP02) — with IFSC codes ZXIN000BP01 and ZXIN000BP02.

nodes.title: Punakha Region
nodes.summary: Punakha region has a single branch opposite Dzong Gate, Punakha Town, with IFSC code ZXIN000BK01 and contact +975-3-584242.

nodes.title: Phuentsholing Region
nodes.summary: Phuentsholing region has two branches — 2nd floor, Shopping Complex, Main Road and near RSTA Office, Dhamdara — with IFSC codes ZXIN000BL01 and ZXIN000BL02.

nodes.title: Gelephu Region
nodes.summary: Gelephu region has a single branch at Samtenling Road, near BCCI Office, Gelephu, with IFSC code ZXIN000BG01 and contact +975-6-251885.
